### Q: Who is Surendra GD?

He has engineered production systems at Half Brain and founded InSpace, authoring over 70,000+ lines of production code.

### Q: What is Surendra GD's core technology stack?
A: Surendra's primary tech stack spans:

- Backend: Java Spring Boot, Laravel (PHP), Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Express.
- Databases & Real-time: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis (Pub/Sub and caching), WebSockets.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, EC2, VPC, ALB), DigitalOcean, Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
- AI & Search Engineering: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, LLM tool security, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

### Q: What did Surendra GD build at Half Brain?
A: At Half Brain (Aug 2024 - Present), Surendra engineered an interconnected multi-app food delivery ecosystem consisting of:
1. Consumer Food Ordering App (web & mobile).
2. Store Merchant Terminal for order ingestion, menu editing, and kitchen ticket printing.
3. Delivery Partner App featuring real-time sub-second GPS live tracking and turn-by-turn route updates.
4. Centralized Order Management Dashboard for live dispatching and operational analytics.
He also built custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enabling AI models to safely execute operational queries on transactional databases.

### Q: What did Surendra GD accomplish with InSpace?
A: As Founder & Full Stack Engineer of InSpace (Dec 2022 - Aug 2024), Surendra engineered a tech community platform with over 70,000 lines of production code:
- Mobile app built in React Native, published to the Google Play Store.
- Real-time chat backed by Java Spring Boot and WebSockets, clustered across nodes with Redis Pub/Sub.
- Cloud deployment on AWS using ECS container tasks, RDS PostgreSQL, S3 media storage, VPC security, and Application Load Balancers.
- Conducted user interviews and developer feedback cycles, executing rapid agile pivots.
